# cargo-audit-ignore.txt
#
# RustSec advisory IDs to WAIVE during `cargo audit` (see .github/workflows/supply-chain.yml,
# job `cargo-audit`). One advisory per line; `#` starts a comment; blank lines ignored.
# Each entry is passed to cargo-audit as `--ignore <ID>`.
#
# Format:  RUSTSEC-YYYY-NNNN
# Policy:  An entry here means the advisory has been triaged and consciously accepted
#          (not exploitable in our usage, or no fixed upstream release exists yet).
#          Every waiver MUST carry a justification comment and, ideally, a tracking link.
#          Un-waived high/critical advisories fail the job closed.
#
# Example (commented out; this repo currently waives nothing):
# RUSTSEC-2024-0384  # instant unmaintained; pulled only by a dev-dependency, no runtime path. Track: OS#NNN
